title: AgriCoco
subtitle: Smart Support for Healthy Coconut
hero_badge: Healthy Trees • Better Yields • Brighter Future
hero_description: Detect coconut diseases and get evidence-based crop health recommendations in English and Kannada.
detect_subtitle: Upload an image of the affected coconut plant for AI analysis.
upload_desc: Drag and drop an image here or choose from your device.
guide_1: Use a clear and well-lit image
guide_2: Focus on the affected part of the plant
about_disease_desc: Gray leaf spot is a fungal disease that affects coconut leaves, causing greyish spots and reduced photosynthesis.
prec_2: Do not use infected planting material
source_authorities: ICAR – Coconut Development Board | ICAR-CPCRI Manuals
about_desc: AgriCoco is an AI-powered web platform designed to support coconut farmers with accurate disease detection and trusted crop-health advisory. Our goal is to help farmers make informed decisions, improve crop health, and increase productivity — using the power of technology and agricultural knowledge.
about_tagline: Healthy Coconut Trees for a Sustainable Tomorrow
